dataset_order: canonical torchvision CIFAR-100 train order; sample_id equals global_index
score_definition: mean cosine distance from each normalized CLS feature to its 20 nearest other normalized CLS features

class_balanced_selection.hard: top-k within each class by descending score
class_balanced_selection.random: RandomState(seed).choice without replacement within each class

source_result_status.ordinary_10_percent: saved aggregate independently audited; no fresh rerun claimed

redistribution_scope: selection indices and derived scalar results only; no images, paths, features, weights, or checkpoints
